summary: SiTime Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the completion of its acquisition of certain timing business assets from Renesas Electronics America Inc. The deal closed on July 1, 2026, for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $1.5 billion in cash plus 3,558,691 shares of SiTime common stock. The cash portion was funded through cash on hand. Concurrently, SiTime entered into a $200 million senior secured revolving credit facility with Wells Fargo as agent. The board recommended the transaction. The acquisition expands SiTime's product portfolio in the semiconductor timing market, and the stock component creates ongoing exposure to SiTime's performance.
